caption: The video captures a twilight landscape under a dark blue-grey sky, where a low, broken cloud band stretches across the horizon and conceals a bright light source. Black silhouettes of a conifer treeline anchor the foreground, with a tall bare tree at the left edge and a thinner tree near center-left. From behind the cloud band, crepuscular rays fan upward, their structure continuously shifting. Early on, many thin, distinct beams spread in several directions, but as the sequence progresses the leftward beams weaken and merge while a broad beam angled up-right grows dominant. As the clip continues, this ray fades slightly, and the other beams soften into a wider, more diffuse glow. The camera and treeline remain steady, while the bright spot near the cloud gap drifts slowly leftward, so the visible motion lies in the evolving pattern of light and cloud edges.
